title: Break all the legs @Leslie Odom Jr.- cannot wait to see you back in t...
transcript: I don't think it has hit me yet that it is the year 2025, and yet tomorrow I am about to see Leslie Odom, Jr. In Hamilton live. Like, that's crazy. I was actually lucky enough to see the show all the way back in 2015 with the original Broadway cast. I saw everyone except for Lynn how Pierre was on for Hamilton. And it is, to date, one of the best theatrical experiences I have ever had. And in a show filled to the brim with really great performances, it really was Leslie's performance that I was most enamored by. He is just one of those performers that I could not take my eyes off him at the entire show. And so if I could bring anyone back from the original cast, it would be him. And so the fact that it is actually happening is just so exciting to me. Obviously selfishly so that I could see his performance again, but also so that so many new people who didn't get to see him the first time around now get to experience his performance live. And I'm really excited to see how his portrayal has changed, because he hasn't done this role in, like, eight or nine years. I just think it's going to be really, really special, and I'm really excited to be in the room where it happens, as it were.
classificationReason: Creator is expressing pre-show anticipation about seeing Leslie Odom Jr. in Hamilton the following day. No first-hand opinion of this production has been formed yet — this is pre-attendance excitement, not a review.
